exposure: Fetal renal artery Doppler indices (Resistance Index - RI, Pulsatility Index - PI)
cohort: The study included 90 pregnant women aged 21-30 years, at 28-36 weeks of gestational age, divided into three groups based on amniotic fluid volume (normal, oligohydramnios, polyhydramnios).
finding: Fetal renal artery Doppler Resistance Index (RI) is a valuable predictor of adverse outcomes in idiopathic oligohydramnios, correlating with higher rates of fetal distress, lower birth weight, and increased caesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: Higher caesarean section rates were observed in oligohydramnios cases and showed a statistically significant correlation with high fetal renal artery Resistance Index (RI) values.
